GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported that his mount travelled comfortably in the lead, however, came under pressure from the 600m and was disappointing in the manner in which the gelding closed off the race. He added that, in his view, the gelding failed to handle the seven-day backup after racing at Forbes on Saturday, 10 October 2026. A post-race veterinary exam revealed no abs.
